try verb

also attempt, try again

classical

Traupman 398

cōnor, cōnārī, cōnātus sum

verb, first conjugation, deponent · Conjugation on Wiktionary

try, attempt

Deponent.

Other words

  • temptō (tentō), temptāre, temptāvī, temptātum — try, attempt; put to the test

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Leg. 1.59: cum sē ipse perspexerit tōtumque temptārit (Lewis & Short s.v. tentō); Traupman 398 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    cōnor is to make an effort to do something; temptō is to try something out, test it, or make an attempt on it.

Examples

  • Vīsne iterum cōnārī?

    Do you want to try again?composed

See also wait.
